name: nbg-unity
description: Unity toolkit for NBG projects: studio coding standard and reward-package workflows. The Unity Editor tools themselves come from the Matrix package.

plugins.name: unity-standard
plugins.description: The portable Unity standard, applied automatically in any Unity project: C# and UI conventions, mockup-to-prefab pipeline, recompile and play-mode verification, package docs and git discipline. Works with or without an Editor MCP bridge.

plugins.name: reward-system
plugins.description: Reward-package deltas on top of unity-standard: the package contract, the package/demo-host boundary, repo UI facts, play-mode levers, Vietnamese docs, git release.
